verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents a personal API key for CLI authentication in automated workflows and an organization Public API. Neither is shown to issue scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. The runtime probe says `bw serve` exposes the whole vault, which is the opposite of scoping, so these are adjacent credential mechanisms rather than the scoped-credential capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
